text:
Maya (People Ops): @here All-hands this Friday 10:30am PT — collecting agenda items + Qs. Quick plan below, drop anything you want covered in replies.

Claire (CEO): excited to share a short strategy update + customer wins.

Sam (Product): will demo the Dedicated autopilot rollout (15m) — can anyone from infra/eng be on standby for live Qs?

Ravi (Eng): happy to join. can we include a quick note about the new batching config defaults?

Maya (People Ops): yes, add it here — we want a 2–3 line summary per item so we can timebox. deadline for Qs: Thu EOD.

Ivy (Design): can we get 5 mins to show the console UX tweaks and new dark-mode mock? small screenshare.

Maya (People Ops): noted. agenda draft:
- 10:30 intro + org updates (Claire)
- 10:40 Product launch + demo (Sam)
- 10:55 Engineering callouts: batching defaults + rollout plan (Ravi)
- 11:05 Console UX update (Ivy)
- 11:12 Customer success highlight + metrics (Nate)
- 11:20 Live Q&A (all)
- 11:30 Close + TL;DR takeaways

announce-bot: Calendar invite: https://calendar.example.com/event/1768503210 (Zoom link in invite)

Nate (Platform): customer metric I'll share is latency p95 down 18% after the cache changes — will drop the graph in the doc.

Sam (Product): request: please surface any rollout blockers in thread so we can triage before Friday.

Ravi (Eng): FYI: policy change to default data retention for debug logs — we'll need to call out what this means for Dedicated customers (short note).

Maya (People Ops): good catch — add the retention blurb to the agenda under "Engineering callouts". Also reminder: submit questions as replies here or use the google form: https://forms.gle/example

Ivy (Design): one Q for panel: will console dark-mode be rolled out org-wide or as an opt-in?

Claire (CEO): we plan opt-in for first week, then org-wide after feedback. can you prepare rollout notes, Ivy?

Ivy (Design): will prepare, thanks.

Ravi (Eng): quick technical note for the team's Qs: if people ask about the batching change, here's the CLI snippet we'll point to:
```
redwoodctl set-batching --profile=balanced --max-batch=64
redwoodctl restart service/inference
```

Sam (Product): adding two customer stories to the demo: legaltech startup + edtech pilot. short bullets only.

Maya (People Ops): thanks — plan to record and post the recording + transcript. Recording link will be posted in this thread after the meeting.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: "All-hands in 24h" to @here.

Claire (CEO): TL;DR for folks who can't make it: 1) New Dedicated autopilot demo + rollout plan, 2) policy tweak: debug log retention change (shorter by default), 3) Console dark-mode opt-in, 4) p95 improvements on platform. Recording + slides will be posted.

Nate (Platform): I'll drop the latency graph and a short note on quantization experiments into the shared folder before Friday: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/abc123

Maya (People Ops): last call for agenda/Qs — if you want a specific live person on the panel, @mention them here.

Ravi (Eng): @Sam @Nate please confirm you can both be on the Q&A panel.

Sam (Product): confirmed.

Nate (Platform): confirmed.

Maya (People Ops): thanks everyone — see you Friday. Recording: will post 30–60m after the meeting. :calendar: :loudspeaker:

(After meeting) announce-bot: Recording + slides are live -> https://videos.example.com/recordings/1768503210 and https://drive.example.com/recordings/1768503210-slides.pdf

Maya (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR:
- Autopilot rollout: canary next week, opt-in for trial customers, full rollout phased over 6 weeks.
- Policy: debug log retention default shortened to 30 days; Dedicated customers can opt to extend via support ticket.
- Console: dark-mode opt-in enabled today; feedback link in slides.
- Platform: p95 latency down ~18% and token cost improvements from KV cache.

Claire (CEO): Thanks team — great demos and clear customer wins. Big props to Eng/Platform for the perf gains.

Ivy (Design): noted — I'll add a short note to the release notes and push the feedback survey.

Sam (Product): I'll open a follow-up doc with rollout checklist and owners.

Ravi (Eng): filed an RFC with the full retention change details: https://docs.redwood.example.org/rfcs/retention-2026

Maya (People Ops): action items captured in the doc. If you asked a question and didn't get answered live, please ping me and I'll route it to the right owner.

Claire (CEO): :clap: Great job.
